group.name: Czech & English Language Club U Studánky
group.description: Welcome to U Studánky Language Club! This group is for expats, foreigners, and international friends who have a passion for learning and practicing Czech and English languages. Our meetups are filled with fun language exchange activities, cultural discussions, and socializing opportunities. Whether you are a beginner or a fluent speaker, join us to improve your language skills, make new friends, and immerse yourself in different cultures. Let's come together to share our love for languages and create a welcoming community where everyone can feel at home. We can't wait to meet you at our next meetup! Na shledanou!

eventName: Webinar with Cosmos Labs: Designing Tokenized Deposits for a Multi-Ledger Future
eventDescription:
Join us for a webinar with Cosmos Labs, an LFDT general member, on Designing Tokenized Deposits for a Multi-Ledger Future. Most tokenized deposit initiatives start within a single institution or consortium, but the architecture choices banks make today will determine how effectively deposits can reach new markets and power new use cases. This session examines how an interoperability protocol fits into a tokenized deposit stack, covering how deposits and data can be exchanged across ledgers without intermediaries, key use cases like cross-border payments, programmable escrow, and collateral mobility, and what changes when interoperability is built in from the start. Designed for CTOs, digital asset leads, and engineering teams planning or running tokenized deposit programs.

The webinar will take place on Wednesday, **November 13** at **7AM PST/10AM EST/16:00 CET/8:30 PM IST**

Please register here: https://zoom.us/webinar/register/8716754539090/WN_vOKR45ECSl2Pp0NpMSAskw

We hope to see you there!

group.name: LFDT Czechia
group.description:
LFDT Meetup groups have an informal relationship with LF Decentralized Trust and make up a key part of the LFDT ecosystem. Participation in a LFDT Meetup group is open to anyone--employees of a LFDT member company, LFDT contributors and developers, and people just passionate about distributed trust technology.

For more information about LFDT, please visit:
[http://lfdecentralizedtrust.org/](http://lfdecentralizedtrust.org/)

For LFDT Meetup Guidelines, please visit:
[http://meetups.lfdecentralizedtrust.org](http://meetups.lfdecentralizedtrust.org)

To stay in touch with the latest LFDT news, sign up to our weekly newsletter:
[https://www.lfdecentralizedtrust.org/newsletter-archive](https://www.lfdecentralizedtrust.org/newsletter-archive)
